notes:
Account summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (product helpdesk + knowledge base). Evaluated Redwood Hosted API first; impressed by dev DX and streaming. Team wants Dedicated for predictable throughput and isolation. POC scope: 2-week dedicated pool (migrated traffic for two routes), canary rollout for model variant v1->v1-quant, and automated fallback (region failover + cheaper variant) if latency or capacity SLOs breached.

Requirements / priorities (shorthand):
- Latency target: p50 < 80ms for short chat turns, p95 < 350ms under production-like batching
- Throughput: sustain 200 RPS steady, spikes to 350 RPS for 10-15m windows
- Cost sensitivity: mid (wants clear unit economics + recommendations from Redwood Optimize)
- Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2, KMS for key management, audit logs retained 13 months, EU data residency for EU users

- Week 1: Canary route - send 5% of production-like traffic to Dedicated instance running model variant A (fp16) + KV cache enabled
- Week 1 end: Evaluate latency, token-cost, and correctness against golden set (evals shared in Drive link)
notes_continued:

- Fallback policy: primary -> dedicated model A; on SLO breach fallback to hosted-compatible variant B (lower-cost quantized) with automatic rollback if quality drop > 2% on eval set
- Rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 500ms for 5 minutes OR error rate > 1.5% OR quality regression on eval prompts > 3%
